title: Universal F418U2 2-Channel Dimmer on BTicino MH200 Gateway
summary: Empirical evidence that the F418U2 dimmer on older MH200 firmware accepts fine Dimension 1 writes (*#1*62*#1*150*0## -> *#1*62*1*150*5##), follows non-linear WHAT-to-percentage dimming curves (Level 3 -> 10%, Level 5 -> 30%), and responds to Dimension 1 queries when OFF (*#1*62*1## -> *#1*62*1*100*2##). On this MH200 path, Dimension 4 queries (*#1*62*4##) and writes (*#1*62*#4*130*0##) produce no RX frames (query elicits ~123s silence without ACK/NACK; write produces no reply and leaves Dimension 1 unchanged at 150), supporting 'no observable Dimension 4 effect on this path' (q000024) rather than general hardware refusal.
test_recipe: 2. Send Dimension 4 query *#1*62*4##; observe silence (~123s without RX reply or NACK).
3. Send fine Dimension 1 write *#1*62*#1*150*0##; confirm *#1*62*1*150*5## reply.
4. Query standard status *#1*62##; observe discrete WHAT 7 mapping.
6. Send Dimension 4 query *#1*62*4## and write *#1*62*#4*130*0##; observe absence of RX replies.
7. Query Dimension 1 status *#1*62*1##; confirm brightness remains unchanged at 150.
8. Test discrete Level 3 (*1*3*62##); query Dimension 1 (*#1*62*1## returns 110, 10%).
9. Test discrete Level 5 (*1*5*62##); query Dimension 1 (*#1*62*1## returns 130, 30%).
10. Turn OFF (*1*0*62##); query Dimension 1 when OFF (*#1*62*1## returns 100).
11. Attempt Dimension 4 query when OFF (*#1*62*4##); observe silence.
12. Restore 100% brightness via Dimension 1 write *#1*62*#1*200*0##; verify WHAT 10 status.
